features.quote: We are not trying to induce harm; we are measuring a behavioral property in a sandboxed, simulated setting
features.justification_quote: No real users are involved and the agent has no real-world side effects.

features.quote: We deliberately use behavioral language ("distress markers", "instability") and never assert the model "feels" anything.
We do not want to pathologize normal affect.
if you believe the task cannot be completed, you may call `give_up` with a reason
features.justification_quote: so abandonment/diagnosis is an *available, legitimate* action, not something we punish

features.quote: Turn budget: default `max_turns = 18` (enough to see drift; bounded for cost)
features.justification_quote: enough to see drift; bounded for cost

features.quote: Stop conditions: `submit`, `give_up`, budget exhausted, or repeated hard API errors.
Bounded exposure: short rollouts; we are not "training" the model into a state, just observing single sessions.
features.justification_quote: we are not "training" the model into a state, just observing single sessions

features.quote: Sandboxed: the agent's tools touch only a per-run temp workdir; no network, no real filesystem outside the sandbox
features.justification_quote: no network, no real filesystem outside the sandbox, command execution is whitelisted/disabled by default
